ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity pixels (white) dominate approximately 90% of the visible surface, contrasted by low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels localized along the trailing edge and lobe tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous high-intensity white field across the central and lateral fluke regions; dark contiguous pigmentation bands (approx. 5-10 pixels wide) trace the entire trailing edge and concentrate at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 80 degrees and a depth of approximately 10% of the fluke's vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary with low-amplitude peaks (1-3 pixels) and valleys occurring at high frequency along the entirety of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep from the median notch extending laterally, with a slight distal taper leading to pointed fluke tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct dark pigmentation and slightly irregular margin at the right lobe tip; small, isolated low-intensity pixel clusters near the mid-trailing edge of the left lobe.
